Cadastral map. Covers northeastern portion of town of Montville, Connecticut. Signed at lower right: Humphry Avery, survr. for the county of New London. Pen-and-ink. Map backed with cloth. Includes notes and text. Imperfect: Scuff marks, tears, and darkening of paper. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
